fields.name: CategoryID
fields.description: FK to categories table; resolved via lookup from legacy ProductGroupName

fields.name: IsActive
fields.description: Active flag. Polarity is inverse to legacy Discontinued column.

fields.name: ReorderPoint
fields.description: Stock level at which a reorder is triggered

fields.name: BusinessUnit
fields.description: Business unit owning the product. Single-tenant migration: all rows take the constant value 'Manufacturing'.

fields.name: SourceSystem
fields.description: Audit field recording the system this row was migrated from. All rows take the constant value 'Legacy ERP'.

fields.name: CategoryID
fields.description: System-generated category identifier (assigned during migration; no source counterpart)

fields.name: CategoryName
fields.description: Display label for the category. One row per distinct ProductGroupName seen in the legacy items table.

fields.name: BusinessSegment
fields.description: Business segment this category sits within. Single-tenant migration: all rows take the constant value 'Industrial'.
